-- 10.3  verify_custom_domain(p_studio_id)
-- Simulates a DNS check by marking the domain verified.
-- In production the worker (cron) calls this or an Edge Function
-- performs the actual DNS lookup and calls this RPC.
-- Only the studio owner may trigger this.
-- -------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_custom_domain(
  p_studio_id UUID
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_domain    TEXT;
  v_verified  BOOLEAN := false;
  v_error     TEXT    := NULL;
BEGIN
  -- Auth: owner only
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members sm
     WHERE sm.studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND sm.user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND sm.role       = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied: owner required';
  END IF;

  -- Fetch pending domain from studios
  SELECT custom_domain
    INTO v_domain
    FROM public.studios
   WHERE id = p_studio_id;

  IF v_domain IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('verified', false, 'error', 'no_custom_domain_set');
  END IF;

  -- The actual DNS lookup happens in the worker / Edge Function.
  -- This RPC records the result supplied by the worker via direct
  -- function invocation with service-role context. For now we
  -- update check_count and last_checked_at on the verification row,
  -- and update studios if verified.
  UPDATE public.domain_verifications
     SET last_checked_at = now(),
         check_count     = check_count + 1,
         error           = v_error
   WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
     AND domain    = v_domain;

  -- Read current verified status after update
  SELECT dv.verified, dv.error
    INTO v_verified, v_error
    FROM public.domain_verifications dv
   WHERE dv.studio_id = p_studio_id
     AND dv.domain    = v_domain;

  IF v_verified THEN
    UPDATE public.studios
       SET custom_domain_verified    = true,
           custom_domain_verified_at = now()
     WHERE id = p_studio_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'domain',   v_domain,
    'verified', COALESCE(v_verified, false),
    'error',    v_error
  );
END;
$$;


-- -------------------------------------------------------------
-- 10.4  get_campaign_audience_count(p_studio_id, p_filters)
-- Previews the number of clients that match a campaign's audience
-- filter before the campaign is sent. Owner/admin only.
--
-- Supported filter keys (all optional):
--   tags            text[]   — client must have ALL listed tags
--   last_visit_days int      — inactive for N+ days
--   min_spent_cents int      — lifetime value >= N cents
--   max_spent_cents int      — lifetime value <= N cents
--   location_ids    uuid[]   — client has a booking at one of these locations
-- -------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_campaign_audience_count(
  p_studio_id UUID,
  p_filters   JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
STABLE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_count INT;
BEGIN
  -- Auth: owner or admin
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members sm
     WHERE sm.studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND sm.user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND sm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access_denied: owner or admin required';
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)
    INTO v_count
    FROM public.clients c
   WHERE c.studio_id = p_studio_id
     -- tags filter: client must have all provided tags
     AND (
       (p_filters->>'tags') IS NULL
       OR c.tags @> ARRAY(
             SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(p_filters->'tags')
           )
     )
     -- inactivity filter
     AND (
       (p_filters->>'last_visit_days') IS NULL
       OR c.last_visit_at IS NULL
       OR c.last_visit_at < now() - ((p_filters->>'last_visit_days')::int * interval '1 day')
     )
     -- minimum lifetime spend
     AND (
       (p_filters->>'min_spent_cents') IS NULL
       OR c.total_spent_cents >= (p_filters->>'min_spent_cents')::int
     )
     -- maximum lifetime spend
     AND (
       (p_filters->>'max_spent_cents') IS NULL
       OR c.total_spent_cents <= (p_filters->>'max_spent_cents')::int
     )
     -- location filter: client has a booking at one of the specified locations
     AND (
       (p_filters->'location_ids') IS NULL
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
           FROM public.bookings b
          WHERE b.client_id    = c.id
            AND b.location_id  = ANY(
                  ARRAY(SELECT (jsonb_array_elements_text(p_filters->'location_ids'))::uuid)
                )
       )
     );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'studio_id',    p_studio_id,
    'filters',      p_filters,
    'audience_count', v_count
  );
END;
$$;


-- -------------------------------------------------------------
-- 10.5  generate_referral_code(p_client_id)
-- Creates a unique referral code for a client. The code is
-- 8 characters: uppercase letters + digits. Retries on collision
-- (collision probability is negligible). Caller must be an
-- authenticated studio member.
-- -------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_referral_code(
  p_client_id UUID
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id      UUID;
  v_code           TEXT;
  v_attempt        INT  := 0;
  v_max_attempts   INT  := 10;
  v_existing_count INT;
  v_result         JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Resolve client's studio and verify caller is a member
  SELECT c.studio_id
    INTO v_studio_id
    FROM public.clients c
   WHERE c.id = p_client_id
     AND c.studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids());

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_not_found_or_access_denied: %', p_client_id;
  END IF;

  -- Check for existing active code
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'code_id',   rc.id,
    'code',      rc.code,
    'existing',  true
  )
    INTO v_result
    FROM public.referral_codes rc
   WHERE rc.studio_id = v_studio_id
     AND rc.client_id = p_client_id
     AND rc.is_active = true
   LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN v_result;
  END IF;

  -- Generate unique code with collision retry
  LOOP
    v_attempt := v_attempt + 1;
    IF v_attempt > v_max_attempts THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'referral_code_generation_failed: max retries exceeded';
    END IF;

    -- 8-char alphanumeric code (uppercase)
    v_code := upper(substring(
      encode(gen_random_bytes(6), 'base64'),
      1, 8
    ));
    -- Replace non-alphanumeric chars that base64 may produce
    v_code := regexp_replace(v_code, '[^A-Z0-9]', 'X', 'g');

    -- Pad or trim to exactly 8 chars
    v_code := substring(v_code || 'XXXXXXXX', 1, 8);

    -- Check uniqueness within studio
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_existing_count
      FROM public.referral_codes rc
     WHERE rc.studio_id = v_studio_id
       AND rc.code      = v_code;

    EXIT WHEN v_existing_count = 0;
  END LOOP;

  -- Insert the new code (default: 10% off, unlimited uses)
  INSERT INTO public.referral_codes (
    studio_id, client_id, code,
    discount_type, discount_value,
    is_active
  )
  VALUES (
    v_studio_id, p_client_id, v_code,
    'percentage', 10,
    true
  )
  RETURNING jsonb_build_object(
    'code_id',  id,
    'code',     code,
    'existing', false
  ) INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$$;

  preferred_dates     DATERANGE,

                        CHECK (status IN ('active', 'offered', 'booked', 'expired', 'cancelled')),
  offered_booking_id  UUID        REFERENCES public.bookings(id),
  offered_at          TIMESTAMPTZ,
  offered_expires_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_waitlist_client_id   ON public.waitlist_entries(client_id);

CREATE TRIGGER set_waitlist_entries_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.waitlist_entries
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();

ALTER TABLE public.waitlist_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "waitlist_entries_select"
  ON public.waitlist_entries FOR SELECT
  USING (studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE POLICY "waitlist_entries_insert"
  ON public.waitlist_entries FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids()));

CREATE POLICY "waitlist_entries_update"
  ON public.waitlist_entries FOR UPDATE
  USING  (studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids()));

    studio_id = ANY(public.user_studio_ids())
